title: Notifications
subtitle: Events for the identity you are using now. Unread first.
emptyDescription: Events for this identity appear here. Use the demo tools to make something happen.
signedOutDescription: Notifications belong to an identity. Enter the demo to see them.
emailAvailable: This event would also send an email.

published.title: Campaign published
published.body: {campaignTitle} is published and open for submissions.
published.emailBody: {campaignTitle} is published. The rate, cap per submission, minimum claim and submission deadline are on the campaign page.

readiness_blocked.title: Publishing blocked
readiness_blocked.body: {campaignTitle} cannot be published: funding evidence or data source readiness is missing.
readiness_blocked.emailBody: Publishing is blocked until funding evidence and data source readiness are both recorded. Nothing was published.

submissions_closed.title: Submissions closed
submissions_closed.body: {campaignTitle} no longer accepts new submissions. Metering continues for posts already accepted.
submissions_closed.emailBody: New submissions are closed. Accepted posts keep metering until their own window ends, and claims stay open for the published grace period.

closed.title: Campaign closed
closed.body: {campaignTitle} is closed. Open cases and confirmed unpaid amounts are still listed.
closed.emailBody: The campaign is closed. Closing does not settle open appeals, pending claims or confirmed unpaid amounts, and any refund of the unused pool is shown as pending verification.

accepted.title: Submission accepted
accepted.body: Your post is accepted and metering has started. Metering ends {meteringEndsAt}.
accepted.emailBody: A baseline was recorded, so only qualified views gained after acceptance count. Metering ends {meteringEndsAt} and you can claim until {claimDeadlineAt}.

baseline_unavailable.title: Baseline not available
baseline_unavailable.body: The source could not give a baseline, so metering has not started. Nothing was rejected.
baseline_unavailable.emailSubject: Waiting for a baseline on your submission
baseline_unavailable.emailBody: Your post was accepted for checks but no trusted baseline exists yet, so metering has not started. Unknown data is not treated as zero views or as fraud.

data_unavailable.title: Source data not available
data_unavailable.body: New reads are failing ({missingReason}). The last trusted value and its time are kept.
data_unavailable.emailSubject: Views cannot be read for your submission right now
data_unavailable.emailBody: The platform data source is unreadable at the moment. The last trusted number and its time are shown, unknown is not counted as zero, and a claim blocked by this can extend the deadline once the outage clears.

resynced.title: Submission resynced
resynced.emailBody: Operations triggered a fresh read of the source. Earlier claims keep the snapshot they were filed against.

approved.title: Content approved
approved.body: The merchant approved your content. This is not a payment.
approved.emailBody: Content review is complete. A claim still needs the metering review before any amount is confirmed, and a confirmed amount is not yet paid.

rejected.title: Content rejected
rejected.body: The merchant rejected your content. Reason: {reason}
rejected.emailBody: Reason: {reason}. Any reservation is held during the appeal window, and you can appeal until {appealDeadlineAt}.

reserved.title: Claim reserved
reserved.body: {amountSen} is reserved and waiting for review. Queue position {seq}.
reserved.emailSubject: Your claim for {amountSen} is under review
reserved.emailBody: {amountSen} is reserved from the reward pool at queue position {seq}. It becomes payable only after both the content review and the metering review are approved.

partial_offer.title: Partial amount offered
partial_offer.body: You could claim {fullSen} but {offeredSen} is available. Confirm the exact amount to reserve it.
partial_offer.emailSubject: A partial amount of {offeredSen} is available
partial_offer.emailBody: The offer reserves nothing and holds no queue position until you consent to the exact amount. If the budget changes the offer must be reconfirmed. The remainder is not forfeited.

waitlisted.title: Added to the waitlist
waitlisted.body: The available budget is below the minimum claim, so nothing is reserved.
waitlisted.emailSubject: You are on the waitlist for {campaignTitle}
waitlisted.emailBody: A waitlist entry holds no money and no queue position. If the budget recovers you are notified and you resubmit, which gives you a new queue position at that time.

confirmed.title: Claim confirmed
confirmed.body: {amountSen} is confirmed and unpaid. It is not in your account yet.
confirmed.emailBody: Both reviews are approved, so {amountSen} is a confirmed obligation. Confirmed unpaid is not paid: a payout is started separately and bank settlement is a further, separate fact.

rejected.title: Claim rejected
rejected.body: The claim was rejected. Reason: {reason}. You can appeal until {appealDeadlineAt}.
rejected.emailBody: Reason: {reason}. The reserved amount is held, not released, while the appeal window is open until {appealDeadlineAt}. Nothing is closed automatically.

escalated.title: Review escalated
escalated.body: This claim passed the 48 hour review target and was escalated. It was not approved automatically.
escalated.emailSubject: A claim passed the 48 hour review target
escalated.emailBody: The claim is escalated for attention. Escalation changes who looks at it, not the outcome: nothing is approved by timeout.

rejection_finalized.title: Rejection final
rejection_finalized.body: Operations finalised the rejection. Reason: {reason}. The reservation is released.
rejection_finalized.emailSubject: A rejected claim is now final
rejection_finalized.emailBody: Reason: {reason}. The appeal window closed or the appeal was rejected, so the reserved amount returns to the available pool.

budget_available.title: Budget available again
budget_available.body: Budget is available again in {campaignTitle}. Resubmit to take a new queue position.
budget_available.emailBody: Budget is available. Resubmitting does not restore an older queue position; the new position is taken at the time you resubmit.

held.title: Metering on hold
held.body: Operations put the metering review on hold. Reason: {reason}
held.emailSubject: A metering review is on hold
held.emailBody: Reason: {reason}. A hold is not a rejection and not an approval. The reservation stays in place while the hold is open.

filed.title: Appeal filed
filed.emailSubject: An appeal was filed on a rejected claim
filed.emailBody: Reason: {reason}. The reserved amount stays held while the appeal is open, and the queue position is unchanged.

upheld.title: Appeal upheld
upheld.body: The appeal was upheld. Review continues from where it stopped. Note: {note}
upheld.emailBody: Note: {note}. Verification continues and the original queue position is kept. An upheld appeal is not a payment.

rejected.title: Appeal rejected
rejected.emailBody: Note: {note}. Operations can now finalise the rejection, which releases the reserved amount back to the pool.

processing.title: Payout processing
processing.body: {amountSen} was sent to the simulated provider. Accepted for processing is not paid.
processing.emailBody: {amountSen} is with the simulated provider. Provider acceptance is not funds in the account and not bank settlement.

paid.title: Funds available
paid.body: {amountSen} is available in the simulated provider account. Bank settlement is shown separately.
paid.emailSubject: {amountSen} is available in your simulated account
paid.emailBody: The simulated provider confirms {amountSen} is available. Whether your bank has settled it is a separate fact and is shown as unknown until confirmed.

failed.title: Payout failed
failed.body: The attempt failed. Reason: {failureReason}. A retry needs this confirmed failure.
failed.emailBody: Reason: {failureReason}. The obligation is still open and a controlled retry is allowed because the failure is confirmed.

unknown.title: Payout result unknown
unknown.body: The provider did not give a result. Reconcile the original attempt. There is no pay again.
unknown.emailSubject: A payout result is unknown and needs reconciling
unknown.emailBody: Unknown is not failed and not paid. The only allowed next step is reconciling this attempt against the provider record; a second payment cannot be started.

reconciled.title: Payout reconciled
reconciled.emailBody: Outcome: {outcome}. Note: {note}. Reconciling records what the provider actually did; it does not move money on its own.

metering_ended.title: Metering ended
metering_ended.body: New views no longer count. You can still claim until {claimDeadlineAt}.
metering_ended.emailBody: Only increments inside the window count. Metering never reopens, but the claim window stays open until {claimDeadlineAt}.

claim_deadline_extended.title: Claim deadline extended
claim_deadline_extended.emailBody: A block ({reason}) stopped you filing across the original deadline, so the full published grace runs again from the time the block cleared. Metering is not reopened and queue times are not back-dated.

claim_deadline_passed.title: Claim deadline passed
claim_deadline_passed.body: New claims are closed for this submission. Claims already filed keep their position.
claim_deadline_passed.emailSubject: The claim deadline for your submission has passed
claim_deadline_passed.emailBody: No new claim can be filed for this submission. Anything filed in time keeps its queue position and continues through review.
